pivot_note: Viv's pivot (the spine at the back of the head); the same pivot as every girl sheet

lower.note: Viv's exported stand boots, drawn under every frame (he stands while he sweeps)

draw_order: draw order: lower (girl_stand_lower), then this sheet frame i (torso, left arm, right arm, flashlight over the hand, cap). The whole sprite turns as one (MOVEMENT_PLAN 1)
state: flashlight raised, on (always: one carry state, as ranger_stand)
loop: 0 out (beam toward his right, screen-left) -> 1 centre -> 2 in (across his body) -> 3 centre; frames 1 and 3 equal ranger_stand, so stand <-> sweep can switch there without a pop
flashlight_note: his light is session 04's flashlight cone, from flashlight_tip along flashlight_angle_deg (deg out from straight ahead = down the sheet; + = toward screen-left, his right). The game may ease the cone between frames; the art swings the arm about the shoulder in whole px
head_note: the cap is drawn in the sheet; head_turn_deg is the cap's turn about the pivot (+ = clockwise on screen, toward screen-left), head_center includes it
